description: This file defines types, macros, enums, and function prototypes for the PWM driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system. It includes version info, error codes, configuration parameters, and API declarations.

methods.name: Pwm_Init
methods.description: Initializes the PWM driver with the provided configuration.

methods.name: Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty
methods.description: Sets the period and duty cycle for a specific PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_SetDutyCycle
methods.description: Sets the duty cycle for a specific PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_GetOutputState
methods.description: Returns the current output state (HIGH or LOW) of a PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_DisableNotification
methods.description: Disables notifications for a PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_EnableNotification
methods.description: Enables notifications for a PWM channel with specified edge notification type.

methods.name: Pwm_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information of the PWM driver.
